module.name: ADB power (Android TV / Google TV)
module.description: Turns an Android TV or Google TV on and off over network ADB.

host.title: TV IP address
host.description: Address of the TV on the local network.

timeout_ms.title: Maximum delay (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Maximum duration of one ADB operation.

unreachable_means_off.title: Unreachable means off
unreachable_means_off.description: Treat the TV as off when it stops answering (deep standby without network).

adb.accept_on_tv: Accept the debugging key on the TV (tick "Always allow").
